name: createFeedLog
description: Record a new feed for the baby with volume in millilitres. Use the current time if the parent does not specify when.

volumeMl.description: Volume of the feed in millilitres (1–500).

loggedAt.description: ISO8601 timestamp. Defaults to now if omitted.

name: updateFeedLog
description: Update an existing feed log by id. Only fields supplied in the arguments are changed; omitted fields are left as-is.

name: deleteFeedLog
description: Delete a previously-logged feed by id.

name: listRecentFeedLogs
description: List the most recent feed log entries, newest first. Use this when the user refers to an existing feed such as 'my last feed'.

limit.description: Defaults to 5. Pass a larger number for 'today', 'this week'.

name: createDiaperLog
description: Record a diaper change. 'wet' is urine only, 'dirty' is stool only, 'both' is both in the same diaper.

name: updateDiaperLog
description: Update an existing diaper log by id.

name: deleteDiaperLog
description: Delete a previously-logged diaper by id.

name: listRecentDiaperLogs
description: List the most recent diaper log entries, newest first.

name: createGrowthMeasurement
description: Record a growth measurement. Provide at least one of weight (grams), height (cm), or head circumference (cm).

name: updateGrowthMeasurement
description: Update an existing growth measurement by id.

name: deleteGrowthMeasurement
description: Delete a previously-logged growth measurement by id.

name: listRecentGrowthMeasurements
description: List the most recent growth measurements, newest first.

name: createMilestone
description: Record a developmental milestone with a short title and optional notes.

name: updateMilestone
description: Update an existing milestone by id.

name: deleteMilestone
description: Delete a previously-logged milestone by id.

name: listRecentMilestones
description: List the most recent developmental milestones, newest first.

name: createMedicalAppointment
description: Schedule a new medical appointment with a title and ISO8601 timestamp. Optional location and notes.

name: updateMedicalAppointment
description: Update an existing medical appointment by id.

name: deleteMedicalAppointment
description: Delete a previously-scheduled medical appointment by id.

name: listRecentMedicalAppointments
description: List the most recent medical appointments, newest first.

name: createPumpingSession
description: Record a new pumping session. Duration in minutes is required.

name: updatePumpingSession
description: Update an existing pumping session by id.

name: deletePumpingSession
description: Delete a previously-logged pumping session by id.

name: listRecentPumpingSessions
description: List the most recent pumping sessions, newest first.
